findings.issue: The full-width space between the two clauses was transcribed as きごう (the word 記号 'symbol' — a tokenizer artifact), inserting a nonexistent word into the phonetic reading of the sentence.
findings.current: まどをあけたきごうするとかぜがはいってきた
findings.suggested: まどをあけた　するとかぜがはいってきた

findings.issue: The whitespace token '　' is assigned the reading きごう ('symbol'). A space has no pronunciation; the reading should be null/empty like its gloss and role.
四つ is read よっつ (yottsu), never よんつ. よん is the reading used with Sino-Japanese counters (四枚, 四本), not with the native counter つ.
findings.current: たまごをよんつつかいました
findings.suggested: たまごをよっつつかいました

findings.issue: In 四つ the numeral 四 is read よっ (forming よっつ), not よん. Wrong reading in context.
In あなたの側にいます meaning 'I am by your side' (location of a person with いる, matching en/pt), 側 is read そば. がわ means 'side (of two)/party' (右側, 向こう側) and is not the natural reading here.
findings.current: わたしわいつもあなたのがわにいます
findings.suggested: わたしわいつもあなたのそばにいます

findings.issue: 側 in this 'by your side' sense (place where someone is, as the token's own role states) is read そば, not がわ.
Contains 'kigou' from the same whitespace-read-as-記号 artifact. This is a wrong inserted word, distinct from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue.
Carries the same wrong reading よんつ of 四つ; should reflect yottsu. Distinct from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue.
Carries the same wrong reading がわ of 側; should reflect そば (soba).

Duplicate tokenization: tokens[0] 会議 and tokens[1] 室 (both with null glosses) are followed by the full compound token 会議室. Concatenating token surfaces yields 会議室会議室は…, which does not reconstruct the sentence. The two split tokens should be removed.
findings.current: 会議 + 室 (split duplicates before the 会議室 token)
findings.suggested: (remove tokens[0] and tokens[1]; keep only the single 会議室 token)

findings.issue: The note calls し the て-form of する; the て-form of する is して. し is the 連用形 (conjunctive stem) to which て attaches. Same error in the en note ('て-form (し) of する'). Teaches a wrong form name.
findings.current: forma て (し) de する, base para ています
findings.suggested: raiz conjuntiva (連用形) し de する; com て forma して, base de ています

findings.issue: 困りました means 'was troubled/at a loss', not 'got lost' (that would be 道に迷った). The translation erases the target word 困る and contradicts lit_en ('I was in trouble') and the explanation.
findings.current: I got lost because I didn't know the way.
findings.suggested: I didn't know the way and was at a loss.

findings.issue: 困りました significa 'fiquei em apuros/sem saber o que fazer', não 'fiquei perdido' (道に迷った). A tradução apaga o vocábulo-alvo 困る e contradiz lit_pt e a explicação.
findings.current: Fiquei perdido porque não sabia o caminho.
findings.suggested: Fiquei em apuros porque não sabia o caminho.

findings.issue: Romanization 'yotsu' in the note is wrong: 四つ is yottsu (よっつ) in modern standard Japanese. Same error in the en note.
findings.current: 四つ (yotsu) = quatro unidades, contador nativo つ
findings.suggested: 四つ (yottsu) = quatro unidades, contador nativo つ

findings.issue: 'As for' is the mirror device for topic は, but 卵 is marked by object を; lit_pt correctly labels it '(を)'. The English literal misrepresents the particle's function in the structural mirror.
findings.current: As for eggs, four (of them) I used.
